summary: El Caso Lookout, Gila NF: 1934 WPA tower and ground house, NRHP-listed 1988; 2020 chapter report says it is unstaffed, neglected and in need of restoration.

facts.design: 31.6-foot Aermotor MC-24 tower with a restored R3 12x12 low-sill cab (register)
facts.status_note: Not staffed; the 2020 report calls the complex neglected and in need of major restoration.

notes_for_editor: Conflicts left open: the register and the 2020 report both describe a restored R3 cab, while the 2020 report says the complex is neglected and needs serious restoration; the story reports both. Height is 31.6 ft in the register; a 30 ft figure appears only in secondary aggregators and was not used. Living New Deal (livingnewdeal.org) returned 403 and its search snippet quotes an NRHP nomination; the snippet is not usable as a quote. The NPGallery PDF link (asset 57417e77-530d-4134-8a5d-61c2f82eb7ff) returned no readable text from the cache, so the nomination was not read. Staffing history, notable fires, current access and rental status are not documented in the readable sources. Staffing and abandonment rely on one chapter report.
